caption: The drawing features two depictions of a single wooden tool with a flat blade, resembling a spade or shovel. The primary object is positioned diagonally from the lower left towards the upper right and consists of a long, brown, cylindrical handle with a horizontal grip at the top and a worn, rectangular wooden blade at the bottom. The blade appears weathered, with visible wood grain and a metallic strip attached to its edge, displaying rust coloration. Above and to the right of the main object, there is a smaller, simplified drawing of the same tool shown from a different angle, highlighting the front of the blade and the handle, using similar brown and beige tones. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are no other objects or adornments on the page.
title: Wooden Spade
